services.title: Website Development
services.summary: Responsive business websites built for fast loading, SEO and lead generation.
services.detail: We build business websites, landing pages and portfolios from scratch. Every site is mobile-first, passes Core Web Vitals and ships with a working contact form, SEO structure and deployment to GitHub Pages or cPanel.
includes: Responsive layout from 320 px to 1920 px
Contact form wired to Google Sheets
SEO meta tags, sitemap and robots.txt

services.title: Web Application Development
services.summary: Custom dashboards, booking tools and management portals built around your workflow.
services.detail: We design and build web apps around the way your team actually works — not off-the-shelf software that forces you to adapt. Typical projects include inventory systems, booking portals, admin dashboards and multi-user management tools.
includes: Deployment to shared or VPS hosting

services.title: Python Automation
services.summary: Scripts that replace daily manual Excel, email and data tasks.
services.detail: If your team repeats the same data task every day, we can automate it. Common projects: reading emails and updating spreadsheets, scraping data and generating reports, scheduling jobs, processing files in bulk.
includes: Windows Task Scheduler or cron setup

services.title: API Integration
services.summary: Connect your apps, payment gateways, CRMs and shipping providers.
services.detail: We wire together the platforms you already use so they share data without manual copying. Typical integrations: Razorpay or Stripe payments, Shopify orders into ERP, WhatsApp Business notifications, third-party CRM sync.

services.title: Business Automation
services.summary: End-to-end automation for reporting, approvals and notifications.
services.detail: Beyond single scripts, we build complete automation pipelines. Typical scope: daily report generation and emailing, multi-step approval flows, customer follow-up sequences, inventory update triggers.
includes: Process mapping before any code is written

services.title: AI Solutions
services.summary: Practical AI tools: data analysis, LLM integrations, automated summaries.
services.detail: We build AI tools that solve a specific problem, not demos. Typical projects: CSV upload and instant analysis with charts, document Q&A with an LLM, automated report summarisation, predictive models on business data.
includes: Problem scoping before choosing a model

services.title: UI/UX Development
services.summary: Interfaces built for real users: clear hierarchy, fast interactions, accessible.
services.detail: We build the front-end layer for web apps where the UI matters — dashboards, customer portals, admin interfaces. All work is accessible, keyboard-navigable and tested across devices.

services.title: Website Maintenance
services.summary: Ongoing bug fixes, updates, security patches and performance work.
services.detail: We handle the ongoing work that keeps a website running well. Scope: bug fixes, content updates, security patches, performance improvements, broken link checks and monthly health reports.

services.title: Video Editing
services.summary: Promotional videos, reels and product demos edited for your brand.
services.detail: We edit promotional videos, product walkthroughs, Instagram and YouTube reels. Deliverables include colour-graded, audio-mixed video exported in platform-ready formats.

services.title: Photo Editing
services.summary: Product retouching, background removal and brand graphic creation.
services.detail: We retouch product photos, remove or replace backgrounds, create social media graphics and produce brand assets for web and print.

projects.title: JadooTech Enterprises Website
projects.problem: Needed a zero-cost lead-capture site that works without a backend.
projects.solution: Static HTML/CSS/JS site on GitHub Pages with Google Apps Script handling form submissions to a private Google Sheet.
projects.result: Live at jadootechenterprises.github.io. Enquiries land directly in Google Sheets as structured rows.

projects.title: Daily Report Automation
projects.problem: Team spent 3 hours each morning copying order data from emails into Excel, then emailing a summary to managers.
projects.solution: Python script runs at 8 am via Windows Task Scheduler. Reads inbox, extracts structured data with regex, updates the master workbook and emails the formatted report.
projects.result: 3-hour daily task reduced to 0 manual minutes. Script has run reliably for 90+ days.

projects.title: E-commerce API Integration
projects.problem: Every Shopify order required manual steps: update ERP stock, send WhatsApp notification, log to Google Sheet.
projects.solution: Python webhook listener on VPS. On each new order: pushes to ERP via REST, fires WhatsApp Business API message, appends row to Google Sheet.
projects.result: 3 manual steps per order eliminated. Integration handles 200+ orders per day without intervention.
